summary: Direct sales to ONE semiconductor solutions distributor customer accounted for 42% of total net revenue for both the quarter and the two quarters ended 2026-05-03, versus 29% a year earlier and 32% for FY2025. Top five end customers approximately 45% (from 40%). Distributors overall 56% of revenue (from 48% in FY2025).
source: Broadcom 10-Q Q2 FY2026 (quarter ended 2026-05-03), SEC — tier-1 + Broadcom 10-K FY2025 (FY ended 2025-11-02), SEC — tier-1
analyst_note: THE SINGLE MOST IMPORTANT RISK FACT IN THIS FILE and the most extreme concentration in this harness — worse than NVDA's 12%-to-22% top-customer move and TSM's 19%. A 13-point jump in one year, amplified by roughly $47.1B of net debt. This is the PRIMARY GATE.

summary: FY2025 net revenue $63,887M (+23.9% on FY2024's $51,574M; FY2023 $35,819M); gross margin $43,294M (67.8%); operating income $25,484M (39.9%); net income $23,126M. R&D $10,977M. Segments: semiconductor solutions $36,858M revenue / $21,232M operating income (57.6% margin); infrastructure software $27,029M / $20,765M (76.8% margin).
analyst_note: Infrastructure software produced nearly as much operating income as semiconductors on 42% of the revenue. VMware is the profit engine of FY2025 — but see the deceleration entry.

summary: Q3 FY2026 revenue $29.6B and adjusted EPS $3.32. AI semiconductor revenue $16.7B, +221% YoY and +54% QoQ. Q4 guidance: AI semiconductor revenue $21.7B (+236% YoY), consolidated revenue $34.8B (+93% YoY), non-GAAP operating margin about 66%. Combining actuals and guidance gives FY2026 revenue near $105.9B, +65.8%.
source: Broadcom Q3 FY2026 results release, 2026-09-02 — headline figures only
analyst_note: POST-DATES ALL SUPPLIED FILINGS and is materially more current. Headline-only: no GAAP income statement or segment detail is available, which is why the FY2026 GAAP earnings figures in valuation.json are ANALYST ESTIMATES. The stock fell about 6.5% after hours despite +221% AI growth, on a Q4 outlook below some expectations.

summary: Shares issued and outstanding: 4,139M (FY2023), 4,686M (FY2024), 4,741M (FY2025), 4,758M (2026-05-03). In H1 FY2026 the company repurchased $8,450M of stock and the count STILL ROSE by 17M. SBC was $7,570M in FY2025 (11.9% of revenue) and $4,268M in H1 FY2026 (10.3%).
source: Broadcom 10-Q Q2 FY2026 (quarter ended 2026-05-03), SEC — tier-1 + Broadcom 10-K FY2025 (FY ended 2025-11-02), SEC — tier-1
analyst_note: THE ONLY COMPANY IN THIS HARNESS WHERE SHARE COUNT IS RISING (Samsung -1.24%, NVDA -2.3%). In fairness the bulk of the multi-year increase was the 544M shares issued as VMware currency — a one-time M&A decision — so underlying net dilution is nearer 0.7% a year. Recorded as INVESTIGATE at MEDIUM rather than HIGH for that reason.

summary: FY2025 capex of $623M on $63,887M of revenue — 1.0%. Operating cash flow $27,537M; free cash flow $26,914M, a 42.1% FCF margin. H1 FY2026 operating cash flow $18,753M (+48% YoY). Capital returned: FY2025 dividends $11,142M and buybacks $2,450M; H1 FY2026 dividends $6,178M and buybacks $8,450M.
source: Broadcom 10-K FY2025 (FY ended 2025-11-02), SEC — tier-1 + Broadcom 10-Q Q2 FY2026 (quarter ended 2026-05-03), SEC — tier-1
analyst_note: The most asset-light business in this harness — capex 1.0% of revenue versus NVDA's 2.8%, Samsung's ~19% and TSMC's 33.4%. Broadcom is fabless, so its wafer capacity risk sits on TSMC's balance sheet rather than its own.

summary: Goodwill $97,801M plus intangible assets net $32,273M equals $130,074M of the $171,092M total asset base (76%), against total stockholders' equity of $81,292M. Property, plant and equipment net is only $2,530M. Total debt principal $67,120M (FY2025) and $66,720M (Q2 FY2026); cash $19,628M at 2026-05-03, giving net debt of roughly $47.1B.
source: Broadcom 10-K FY2025 (FY ended 2025-11-02), SEC — tier-1 + Broadcom 10-Q Q2 FY2026 (quarter ended 2026-05-03), SEC — tier-1
analyst_note: Goodwill ALONE exceeds book equity by roughly $16.5B — tangible book value is deeply negative. The only materially levered balance sheet among the four names analysed; Samsung, NVDA and TSM all hold net cash.

summary: FY2025 net income of $23,126M EXCEEDS pretax income of $22,729M because of a $397M tax BENEFIT, against a $3,748M provision in FY2024. Acquisition-related intangible amortisation was $8,062M in FY2025 ($6,031M in cost of revenue, $2,031M in operating expense) — 32% of reported operating income.
analyst_note: Combined with SBC, the GAAP-to-non-GAAP margin gap is roughly 20 percentage points. Roughly half the add-back is SBC, which is demonstrably a real cost since the share count is rising. Every valuation test in this file therefore uses GAAP. The tax benefit is unexplained in the material reviewed and needs the tax footnote.

summary: Infrastructure software revenue grew 26% in FY2025 but only 5.1% in H1 FY2026 ($13,974M versus $13,300M) and 8.8% in Q2. Semiconductor solutions revenue grew 78.5% YoY in Q2 FY2026 to $15,009M, taking semiconductors to 67.6% of quarterly revenue from 58% in FY2025.
source: Broadcom 10-Q Q2 FY2026 (quarter ended 2026-05-03), SEC — tier-1 + Broadcom 10-K FY2025 (FY ended 2025-11-02), SEC — tier-1
analyst_note: The VMware subscription conversion is largely complete, so the second engine is now close to ex-growth. A two-engine story is becoming a one-engine story, and the remaining engine — custom ASIC — is the more contestable one, since sockets are re-competed at each generation.

summary: Semiconductor solutions operating margin 55.7% (FY2024), 57.6% (FY2025), 61.8% (Q2 FY2026). Infrastructure software operating margin 65.1% (FY2024), 76.8% (FY2025), 78.7% (Q2 FY2026).
source: Broadcom 10-Q Q2 FY2026 (quarter ended 2026-05-03), SEC — tier-1 + Broadcom 10-K FY2025 (FY ended 2025-11-02), SEC — tier-1
analyst_note: Margins expanding while semiconductor revenue grew 78.5% YoY is the clearest evidence growth is not bought. It is why low_quality_growth reads PASS. Note the contrast with the concentration trend — Broadcom is earning more per dollar from steadily fewer customers.

summary: Close $357.16 on 2026-09-03, down 2.74%, after the stock fell about 6.5% following the 2026-09-02 Q3 release. At 4,758M shares that is roughly $1,699B of market capitalisation; adding net debt of about $47.1B gives an enterprise value near $1,747B. On ESTIMATED FY2026 GAAP EPS of $9.39 the multiple is 38.0x; on estimated non-GAAP EPS of $12.26 it is 29.1x.
source: Market price (tier-4) combined with tier-1 share count from the 10-Q
analyst_note: The highest GAAP multiple among the four names analysed. Probability-weighted five-year return is only about +9.6% total (1.8% annualised) — better than Samsung's +5.8% but well below NVDA's +21.2% and TSM's +37.9%.

summary: 공식 Q3 FY2026 자료에는 GAAP 재무제표가 있다. 소프트웨어 매출 87.52억 달러(+29%)는 기존 저성장/단일 성장축 판단의 반증이다. 단일 유통업체 매출 42%를 최종고객 1곳의 경제적 수요 42%로 해석한 것도 정정한다.
analyst_note: 과거 충돌 주장은 삭제하지 않고 역사로 보존. 현행 판단은 동일 날짜 재평가 오버레이가 우선한다.

summary: Q3 FY2026 공식 실적: GAAP 영업이익 $15.955B, FCF $13.665B, 소프트웨어 매출 $8.752B(+29%). 기존 GAAP 자료 부재·소프트웨어 저성장 주장을 정정.
analyst_note: 고객집중과 미래 약정은 별도의 미해결 질문이다.
